legacy_reference.note: 2027 development source, not the locked last legacy release

availability_policy: Systemcore is the only supported robot-controller context; roboRIO is out of scope. Intended host targets are not a support claim: materialize only a release-validated host/Systemcore subset.
constraint_policy: Symbolic review requirements; current client supports only numeric minimum versions. Exact/range/cohort and provider requirements need design/implementation before deployment.

publishers.distribution: Installer distribution maintenance CI: JDK, Gradle, editor and curated language-extension releases; one writer composes its complete snapshot.
publishers.gradlerio: GradleRIO release CI owns build-support closure.
publishers.core: allwpilib release CI owns SDK, built-in training support, five native desktop tools and Java/C++ API documentation.
publishers.toolchains: Systemcore toolchain release CI (e.g. opensdk); season feed selects a tested Systemcore OS/architecture and SDK ABI combination.
publishers.robotpy: RobotPy coordinated release assembly: standalone runtime, host closure, target closure and API documentation.
